newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $2.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week, USDA said. Bulk supply Medium and Large 1- 2 300-750 lb feeder steers and heifers.
Trade moderate. Demand fairly good. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 52 percent, over 600 lbs 45 percent with cows and bulls around 3 percent of total supply.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 70.25-76.00, package 608 lbs 78.50; 700-725 lbs 70.25-73.50, lot 753 lbs fleshy 66.50 package 804 lbs 66.25; part load 874 lbs fleshy 60.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs
